issues.description: The Milkable.messageOnMilk method is declared and used without parameters in the problem statement and the template (calls like m.messageOnMilk()), but the solution repository defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) and implements it with a volume parameter. This parameter mismatch (and the solution's different return text including the volume) will cause compilation errors for code that expects a no-argument messageOnMilk(), and conflicts with the specified behavior "[Animal Type] [name] is milked".
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable interface and its implementations match the problem statement and template by removing the volume parameter: declare String messageOnMilk() in Milkable and update Seal and Goat to implement messageOnMilk() returning "[AnimalType] [name] is milked". Alternatively, if the volume parameter is desired, update the problem statement and template usages (and tests) to include the parameter consistently.
